3057550.Description:
When Heroic Melody is cast, Encore's CD is reduced by 2s.
The buff effect applied by Finale Command is doubled when applied to yourself.

3057560.Description: When Healing Beat is cast, Encore's CD is reduced by <style="accent-gn">0.8s</style>.

3057570.Description: While an actively cast Encore effect is active, when you trigger Encore Strings for an ally, the multipliers of the next <style="accent-gn">2</style> Encore damage instances and <style="accent-gn">2</style> Encore healing instances triggered by the target themselves within the next <style="accent-gn">5s</style> are multiplied by <style="accent-gn">10</style>.

2401160.Description: When Flash Strike, Raijin Dash, or their enhanced skills (Dracoflash, Phantom Slash) deal Crit DMG, Final DMG +15%.

2401290.Description: When Moonstrike deals DMG to its primary target, Stormflash's CD is reduced by 0.7s.

2402170.Description: After every 80 Lucky Strikes, the next DMG instance triggers Blizzard (at most once every 10s). Each time Blizzard is summoned, Intellect increases by 2.5% for 15s, stacking up to 3 times.

2402300.Description: Every 2 active casts of Permafrost grant Raging Tide: During the next actively cast Permafrost, Tidepool always Crits and can trigger Lucky Strike. Immediately gains Raging Tide upon entering combat.

2403180.Description: Every 3 casts of Vortex Strike, the third cast triggers 2 consecutive hits.

2403300.Description: Wind Fury can stack up to 2 times (but the additional stack is only 30% as effective).

2404190.Description: After casting Regen Pulse, increases DMG from Lucky Strike by 20% for 20s. Whenever Thorn is reinflicted to the target, the remaining DMG is dealt immediately based on how many DMG instances remained from the previous infliction.

2404300.Description: Grove Wish's overhealing converts into a shield that lasts for 10s (stacking up to 20% of the target's HP).

2406180.Description: When Sandshroud deals DMG to the primary target, there is a 20% chance to restore 1 Sand Crystal.

2406300.Description: During Sandshroud, Granite Fury is guaranteed to trigger Weakness Strike.

2405180.Description: During Focus, every 1% Mastery grants 0.3% Crit DMG.

2405280.Description: During Focus, whenever Explosive Arrow detonates, Radiance Barrage's CD is reduced based on the detonation stacks (0.5s per stack, up to 10s).

2408160.Description: While in Rhapsody of Flame, Crit DMG from Lucky Strike is always calculated as 180%.

2408290.Description: After casting Healing Beat, increases Crit Healing by 5% per stack for 6s, up to 3 times.

2407180.Description: Photophobia's ATK reduction now applies against everyone (this effect does not stack. Only one instance can be active at a time), and the effect on the applier is additionally increased by 5%.

2407320.Description: After dealing DMG to the primary target 20 times, gains 1 stack of Lightforged Barrier. DMG dealt to you by units bearing a Holy Mark is reduced by 0.5% per Lightforged Barrier.

2409140.Description: During Wasteland's End, each stack of Formless gained reduces Wasteland's End's CD by 1.5s when the effect ends, up to 10s.

2409160.Description: Entering Bloodboil extends Endless Hellfire's duration (including Endless Hellfire activated while in the Bloodboil state). When exiting the Bloodboil state, reduces Endless Hellfire's CD. The duration increase or reduction equals 5s × (1 + Haste%).

2401150.Description: Each time Thunder Cut is cast, reduces Ultimate Skill CD by 1s. Each time an Ultimate Skill is cast, reduces Volt Surge's CD by 5s.

2401280.Description: While Breath of Mark is active, Lucky Strike Multiplier +30%.

2402160.Description: Frost Lance and Meteor Storm Crit DMG +15%.

2402290.Description: During Permafrost, Casting SPD increases by 2% every second, up to 10%. When the maximum is reached, Intellect increases by an additional 5%.

2403170.Description: After every 8 active casts of Courage-consuming skills, 1 Drake Cannon is fired automatically. Every 100 Courage restored reduces Galeform's CD by 1s.

2404180.Description: For 8s after casting Stag Charge, DMG taken is reduced by 15%, and 2 Energy is restored every second.

2404290.Description: Life Bloom's Healing Strength increases by 10%, plus an additional 5% for each stack of Nourish on the target.

2406170.Description: After Star Shatter hits a target, DMG dealt by the target to you is reduced by 5% for 6s.

2406290.Description: Casting Stone Fist reduces Sandshroud's CD by 0.5s.

2405170.Description: When Storm Arrow deals damage, reduces Focus's CD by 0.05s (up to 6s of reduction per CD period).

2405270.Description: Casting Quadraflare increases Crit DMG by 3% per stack for 10s, up to 4 times.

2408150.Description: While Heroic Melody is active, if Lucky Strike fails to trigger a Crit, Crit Rate increases by 3% each time, then resets after triggering.

2408280.Description: For 10s after casting Fivefold Crescendo, increases Crit Healing by 10%.

2407170.Description: When Reckoning or Inferno Reckon hits a target, inflicts Photophobia on the target: The target's ATK against the applier is reduced by 5% for 5s.

2407310.Description: The first instance of DMG received from each monster is reduced by 60%.

2409130.Description: After casting an Ultimate Skill, immediately gains an S rating, and increases ATK by 12% for 15s.

2409150.Description: DMG from Wildfire Dance (including its enhanced final slash) and Great Crimson Lotus nullifies 30% of the target's Armor.
